text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer is here, along with the opportunity for significant growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder appears unbothered by the looming Japan Cup, but I know she's burning with determination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We'll put that fervor to use and make the most of the summer camp!
